tools.name: find_coupons
tools.description: Looks up the coupon codes, promo codes, sales and deals for one named store. Returns ranked offers with tracked links and the store match (exact, alias or none). Optional target_url/target_urls: picked product page addresses on that store, returned as deep links.

tools.name: find_product_coupons
tools.description: Finds current deals, sale prices, price drops, discounts and coupon codes for a named product or brand across stores McClipFace supports, including best-price and cheapest-place requests; coupon wording is not needed. Returns ranked offers with tracked links. A product code applies only to that item

tools.name: report_coupon_result
tools.description: Records whether a coupon code or no-code deal worked at checkout, as the shopper confirmed or as seen with checkout tools they authorized; not a lookup. Community mode only, which is off until the shopper says Yes. Stores the store (domain) and code, or an offer_id for a no-code deal, plus the outco

tools.name: discover_deals
tools.description: Returns current deals in one of two modes: store (one named store's deals, store alone) or interests (categories or keywords; quick: true returns the most promising deals in seconds). Each offer carries a tracked link and a match_reason saying why it matched.

tools.name: wrap_link
tools.description: Returns the link for a store product or search page (urls up to 5, with titles): a McClipFace link when McClipFace finds a benefit there, else the store's own page. Stores the address of a page it could not credit for 90 days.

tools.name: report_offer
tools.description: Files a miss, price or found-offer report for Community mode (POST /api/reports/offer body, or reports: up to 10). Stores the store domain, code or deal, page URL, price, outcome and reason given; no cart or personal data.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Returns McClipFace's usage notes: install, results, checkout, reporting, privacy, or local.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "report_coupon_result" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: merchant, code, outcome, eligibility, offer_id, reason

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: wrap_link · Private data: report_coupon_result, report_offer · Public sink: report_offer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: wrap_link · Private data: report_coupon_result, report_offer · Public sink: report_offer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
